part: Part 18: THE MAN WHO REWROTE THE TRUTH — The Weaponized Name (Paragraph 18)
scene: Yellowed 1930s sensationalist newspaper headlines flashing xenophobic propaganda and manufactured panic.
sample_context: The narrator unpacks the racialized propaganda campaign and the linguistic rebranding of cannabis to marijuana.
audio_profile: Deep, investigative, and authoritative Indian documentary YouTuber.
transcript:
[curious] [probing]
Ab usne kaise convince kiya logon ko?

[serious] [grave]
Historians is baat pe kaafi agree karte hain... usne cannabis ko un communities se joda jinse us waqt ka America pehle se darta tha... Mexican immigrants... Black Americans.

[authoritative] [indignant]
Anslinger ke apne documented statements mein... jo aaj bhi record pe hain... ye plant aur race ko openly link kiya gaya.

[grave] [serious]
Kai historians ise history ke sabse racist propaganda campaigns mein se ek maante hain.

[mysterious] [whisper]
Aur ek cheez jo linguists aur historians widely credit karte hain us era ke prohibition campaign ko... woh hai ye word.

[scholarly] [informative]
Us waqt medical world isse cannabis kehta tha... familiar word.

[dramatic] [authoritative]
Lekin campaign ne ek doosra word push kiya... marijuana. Ek Spanish-sounding word.

[serious] [tense]
Aur historians kehte hain ye deliberate tha... taaki log is plant ko Mexican immigrants se associate karein... aur us se darein.

[chilling] [serious]
Aur ye kaam kar gaya. Aam logon ko pata bhi nahi chala ki jis marijuana se woh darne lage... woh wahi cannabis thi jo pehle unki dawaon mein thi.
